items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: my first trip to Europe was with the George Wein Newport thing. That was Coleman Hawkins, Howard McGhee, Thad Jones, J.J. Johnson, Sonny Stitt, myself, Miles Davis.

ctx.x: Let's see, I took a trip to Europe with Basie in 1960, '62. 1962, I went with Basie. I went for three months and stayed a year, you know? And that's when Jaws* was with the band. We did some dates over there with Tony Bennett. Let's see, was that '62? I think it was, because my first trip to Europe was with the George Wein Newport thing. That was Coleman Hawkins, Howard McGhee, Thad Jones, J.J. Johnson, Sonny Stitt, myself, Miles Davis.
